_readme: SERVER-ONLY. Never import this from a page/component. Edit values here (or paste the whole object into the HUNT_ANSWERS_JSON env var to override without committing answers). Matching is case-insensitive and ignores spaces/punctuation. A null answer, or one containing '?', means 'not filled in yet' and that stage will reject everything. Run `npm run check-content` after editing.

1_cap_table._note: Take the ownership %s whose last digit is 9, 7, 5, 3, 1 (descending): 29% Benjamin (B), 17%/7% Rithul/Riya (R), 15% Angel (A), 3% Vedansh (V), 11% Evan (E). Koza (18%) is the decoy.

2_term_sheet._note: Visible numbers in order: 6% discount (F), 21% option pool (U), 14x liq pref (N), 4 board seats (D), 5-month vesting cliff (E), 4-month runway (D).

3_pitch_deck._note: S = first letter of the first word on the top-left wooden badge (Welcome Center), M = Swartz Center wall words, 8 = Millie's classic price, 1 = last digit of TEP 2701.

4_fence._note: On-screen marketing hint -> the Fence; '5:30 in white - SEP' written on the bench next to it points to Hunt Library. Solving this shows the OUR PITCH + spiral riddles in the app (footbridge -> Gates). Nothing is printed.

6_gates._note: 42 real steps down the spiral. The in-app spiral riddle reads $840K cash / $20K per month burn = 42. Pillar at step 42 is chalked X7G0; X7GO (letter O) is also accepted since the zero is easy to misread.
